## What changed

- **Swift source links.** Wiki links now resolve Swift declarations and type members through the shared source parser.
- **More syntax languages.** The web UI supports all bundled Highlight.js languages and aliases.
- **Search indexing correction.** Search indexes section content correctly and skips text before the first heading.
- **Optional prompt expansion.** Claude and Codex prompt hooks no longer expand wiki references automatically. The `lat expand` command remains available.
- **Fork integrations remain intact.** Ruby, ERB, and Rake source support, memory search and federation, and Diátaxis scaffolding and structural checks remain available.
- **Init test isolation.** Two init tests now mock the current core configuration and menu modules instead of obsolete module paths.

The init version advances so existing projects receive the updated agent instructions on their next `lat init`.
